saw_lines: Buyers of roofing and metal sheet compare full quotes, not price per sheet, and pick whoever looks complete first.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides if this supplier is worth a quote.
Your 25 live ads show no proof number, so buyers get no reason to trust the quote. Put one verifiable count, like reviews or orders shipped, on every new creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of your 25 live ads shows a proof number, so a buyer comparing quotes has nothing to weigh against the price. Collect one verifiable count, such as reviews or orders shipped, and lead the next ads with it.

Your median ad runs 148 words and the longest 239 words, so most buyers quit before the price and the reason to act. Cut each ad to two short lines of copy and the price, and put the price line first.
0 of 20 ads with fixed copy mention an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Open new ads with a first order deal and a bundle with accessories, and name the price in line one.

18 ads have run 60 days or more, yet none of the 7 newer ads reuses the opening line of a winner. Build the next ads as variations of your best winner, keeping its opening idea and swapping only the product.
